title: Innovation on Wings: Nonstop Flights and Firm Innovation in the Global Context
authors: Dany Bahar; Prithwiraj Choudhury; Do Yoon Kim; Wesley Wu-Yi Koo
eligible_reason: No DiD design. Identification is a fuzzy regression discontinuity at the 6,000-mile distance threshold beyond which nonstop flights become infeasible for narrow-body aircraft: reghdfe <innovation outcome> dist6000 c.dist6000#c.under6000 (ltotalFlights = under6000) within a 550-mile triangular-kernel bandwidth, with country-pair-year FE (ccy). Table 8 is a cross-sectional IV (ivreghdfe ... (conn2015 = sharebelow6k)), and the remaining tables are RD heterogeneity splits and price/duration regressions. No binary treatment switching on at unit-specific dates; the 'difference-in-differences' text hit does not correspond to any estimated specification in the package.
design_notes: Country/airport-pair-year panel of patent citations and collaborations (data_RD.dta). Running variable dist6000 (distance minus 6,000 miles); instrument under6000; endogenous regressor ltotalFlights (asinh nonstop flights). Tables 2-7: RD-IV with weights from triangular kernel; Table 8: cross-sectional IV; Table 9: price/duration on innovation with country-pair FE.
estimators_reported: fuzzy RD with IV (reghdfe with endogenous ltotalFlights)

specs.exclusion_reason: regression discontinuity / IV; no staggered binary treatment

screener_notes: Screened from package only (readme.pdf, tables.do, graphs.do, regression inventory). No article text available.
